title: Dept. Q Summary, Trailer, Season List, Cast, Where to Watch and More
text:
Dept. Q follows Carl Morck, a former top detective in Edinburgh, as he is assigned to investigate a cold case after a traumatic attack leaves his partner paralyzed and another officer dead. The series explores Morck's journey as he grapples with guilt and challenges within his new role.
Gritty and great story line. Season 1 was long enough to enjoy the story line and build the characters back story. Looking forward to season 2.
Dept. Q pulls you into its world and refuses to let go, leaving a lasting impression. Whether you’re binge-watching the entire series in one weekend or savoring each episode slowly, *Dept. Q* is a journey worth taking.
Starring the immensely talented Matthew Goode, The supporting cast is equally stellar:Jamie Sives, Leah Byrne, and Alexej Manvelov.
If you’re a fan of the genre or simply enjoy a meticulously crafted mystery, *Department Q* will leave you captivated and wanting more.
Dark Alexej ManvelovAkram SalimLeah Byrne
